tests.name: Settings → Privacy (phone) shows "Introduce me to the community" on and off; read-only, the switch is never flipped
Opt-in filter on both new-member listings, the Settings switch, the registration step, the migration and the texts
tests.reason: Staging writes to the production database (CLAUDE.md rules 31-32, 48), so switching the setting and registering a member cannot run there. These suites prove what the read-only staging spec cannot: an opted-out or unknown newcomer gets no card on either feed tab, the switch writes only community_intro_opt_in on the member's own row, the registration step writes only an explicit no, and a failed read shows no card. The column's defaults (existing members false, new signups true), the owner-only write and the unchanged realtime/RLS setup are proven on PGlite: docs/validation/VTID-05206/outputs/pglite-community-intro-check.txt.
